scientific_integrity: Axiomatic homotopy-pushout and Mayer–Vietoris proof, finite standard-library verification for orders two and three; bibliographic priority limited by indexing.
scientific_limitations: The proof addresses finite projective planes and at most q star-incidence edge deletions, with radius-two graph distances recomputed. It does not address arbitrary failures or later thresholds. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Primitive radius-two Rips persistence under star-incidence faults in finite projective planes
